notes.title: DEATH IN UNISON | MINI PATCH 7
notes.notes:
What up peeps!

Wanted to start off and say that the reception of the game has far exceeded my expectations. I am so super grateful to everyone who has played it. The success of this game has allowed me to pursue my game development career as a full time developer. I've got plenty more games and ideas that I want to make and provide to ya all, so stay tuned!

But first, another lil update for DEATH IN UNISON. Notes below:


ADMITTANCE had an issue where the grading with multiple crimes was taught in an unintuitive way. The duty will now only provide one type of crime to prevent confusion and misunderstanding.
ACCESS training now shows on the intended day
Fixed bug where dying to SACRA would cause some whacky stuff to happen
Fixed bug where the keypad noise on the cooking screen would play twice.
Fixed issue with navigating the files on the secure network.
Fixed issue where roles could be swapped in SOLO.
Reworded some descriptions for better clarity.

notes.title: DEATH IN UNISON - MINI PATCH 5
notes.notes:
Here we go again! I haven't changed the voice chat framework yet but have added a new gain slider. Notes below.


Added a 'MIC INPUT VOLUME' slider into the options. Keeping this value low should prevent the nasty inaudible noise that some people experience.
Slightly rebalanced audio.
Fixed issue where CRAG would get stuck in a door in solo.
Reworked the behind-the-scenes of achievements. They should be a lot more reliable with unlocking now.
Fixed rare rotation issue when grabbed by GLOM while the upgrade is active.


Cheers,
BlnkDev

notes.title: DEATH IN UNISON - MINI PATCH 4
notes.notes:
More daily fixes to improve the experience for you all. Check em out below.


Reworded part of admittance training to clarify the grading system.
Fixed issue which caused termination by mistakes to occur while not in a blackout.
The mic input levels were causing unintended 'scratchiness' for some players. This has now been reduced. Mic volumes may be quieter but are now easier to understand.

notes.title: DEATH IN UNISON - Mini Patch 3
notes.notes:
I messed up the first release for this update. If you were using the previous update before it reverted, your save files may get corrupted. If this is case, please get in contact with me on Discord and I can see if I can provide a save which gets you back to where you were.

Discord - https://discord.gg/QFgYmUSSy6


Reduced volume of the walkie talkie static.
Distance for merchant dialogue to trigger has been reduced in co-op.
Removed effect where walkie talkies intensify when getting terminated. This was causing unintended behavior so it felt better to remove it.
Removed collision on a column to prevent HAPPY from blocking the player in a specific corner.
Fixed case where a new save would be started at day 00.
Fixed issue that caused GENPOP to get stuck in the ground.
Fixed issue where sprinklers would disable itself when it wasn't used.
Fixed issue where the voice chat icon wouldn't display when talking.


Cheers,
BlnkDev

notes.title: DEATH IN UNISON - Mini Patch 2
notes.notes:
Another lil patch to attack some of those pesky bugs people have encountered. Check what's changed below.


DAEMON - Fixed issue where the body would not fully appear.
Fixed issue where a player would be unable to use the walkie talkie after restarting the day.
Fixed a rare case where a player would spectate a terminated player
The secret overlay in the main menu will no longer show when watching the co-op or introduction video.

notes.title: DEATH IN UNISON - Mini Patch 1
notes.notes:
WOW! Absolutely grateful for the feedback so far. It means a lot to see the positive feedback.

I've released a mini patch that mainly fine-tunes the intensity of duties throughout the nights. I feel as though it was requiring too much urgency to get them done in a small timeframe. Patch notes below.


CHOW Duty - Time to complete orders has been drastically increased.
CHOW Duty - Frequency of orders has been drastically reduced.
ACCESS Duty - Time to allow/deny has been drastically increased.
SOLO ONLY - Frequency of convicts increases each day starting from day 6 to day 10
The walkie talkie SFX has been modified. It should now be louder and clearer to understand.
Squashed a bug which caused the 'spectating' text to display when not spectating.


Thanks once again!

Take care,
BlnkDev
